description: Core domain types: Request, Response, MatchRule, Template, Session

exports: class Request: method: str, path: str, headers: dict[str, str], body: bytes
class Response: status: int, headers: dict[str, str], body: bytes
class MatchRule: path_pattern: str, method: str|None, header_patterns: dict[str, str], body_contains: str|None
class Template: content: str, content_type: str
class Session: id: str, state: dict[str, Any]
guarantees: Immutable dataclasses
JSON serializable

description: Parse match patterns from strings and JSON into compiled MatchRule objects

guarantees: Compiled patterns execute in O(n) where n = input length

description: Request matching engine: evaluates Request against MatchRule set and returns first match

exports: def MatcherEngine.register_rule(self, rule: MatchRule, priority: int) -> None
raises: CollisionError on overlapping patterns at registration
guarantees: First matching rule wins
O(m * n) match time where m = rules, n = request size
Collision detection catches ambiguous patterns before runtime

description: Template string evaluation with variable substitution from request and session

exports: def evaluate_template(template: str, context: dict[str, Any]) -> str
guarantees: Missing variables render as empty string
Linear time evaluation relative to template size

description: Response builder: evaluates templates, applies session state, generates Response objects

exports: def build_response(engine: ResponderEngine, match_rule: MatchRule, request: Request, session: Session) -> Response
def register_template(engine: ResponderEngine, rule_id: str, template: Template) -> None
raises: KeyError on missing template for rule
guarantees: Response body is UTF-8 encoded
Content-Type header matches template content_type

description: In-memory session state store with TTL and namespace isolation

exports: def create_session(store: StateStore, ttl_seconds: int) -> Session
def get_session(store: StateStore, session_id: str) -> Session|None
def update_session(store: StateStore, session: Session) -> None
guarantees: Expired sessions return None
Namespace isolation: session_id A cannot access session_id B state
Thread-safe operations

description: Load OpenAPI spec and generate mock rules from paths and response schemas

raises: OpenAPIError on unsupported version or malformed spec
guarantees: Each path generates at least one MatchRule
Response schemas converted to example templates

description: Configuration validation, defaults, and environment variable binding

exports: class Config: port: int, host: str, log_level: str, ttl_default: int, max_sessions: int
def load_config(env: dict[str, str], file_path: str|None) -> Config
raises: ValueError on invalid port or malformed config file
guarantees: All fields have default values
Environment variables override file values

description: Request processing orchestrator: coordinates matcher, responder, and state

exports: def create_orchestrator(matcher: MatcherEngine, responder: ResponderEngine, store: StateStore) -> Orchestrator
def handle_request(orch: Orchestrator, request: Request) -> Response
guarantees: Session created on first request if not provided
404 response when no match rule found

description: HTTP server with request routing, middleware chain, and graceful shutdown

exports: def create_server(config: Config, handler: Callable[[Request], Response]) -> HTTPServer
guarantees: Graceful shutdown on SIGTERM
Request timeout after 30 seconds
Concurrent request handling

description: Admin HTTP endpoints for runtime rule inspection and modification. Returns a handler function that routes /__admin/* paths to admin operations.

exports: def create_admin_handler(matcher, responder, store) -> Callable[[Request], Response]
guarantees: Handler checks request.path startswith ADMIN_PREFIX before routing
GET /__admin/rules returns JSON list of registered matcher rules
POST /__admin/rules accepts JSON body, creates MatchRule, registers via matcher
DELETE /__admin/sessions/{id} clears session via store.delete_session()
Non-admin paths return None (caller must handle fallback)

description: CLI argument parsing, config loading, and command dispatch

guarantees: Exit code 0 on clean shutdown
Exit code 1 on config error
Exit code 2 on runtime error

description: System bootstrap: wire components, load initial rules, start server

exports: def initialize_system(config: Config, spec_path: str|None) -> SystemContext
class SystemContext: matcher: MatcherEngine, responder: ResponderEngine, state: StateStore, server: HTTPServer
guarantees: All components share consistent state references
OpenAPI rules loaded before server starts
Cleanup handlers registered for graceful shutdown
